title: Descent of specialization-invariant functions along a flat surjective family
statement: Let X be a topologically noetherian scheme, V_i any indexed family of schemes with flat maps f_i jointly surjective on points, and A any type. Suppose functions r_i:V_i to A agree over equal base points and are invariant under specialization in each V_i. Then there is a locally constant d:X to A whose pullback to each V_i is r_i.

source.place: Example 3.1; agent rank/descent argument in original node, Descent of specialization-invariant functions along a flat surjective family

proof.text: Choose a lift of each point of X and use fibre compatibility to obtain the pullback equality for any lift.
Flat.generalizingMap lifts a generalization at the chosen point. Specialization invariance upstairs proves specialization invariance downstairs. This uses the Mathlib theorem for flat maps directly.

There are finitely many irreducible components of X, each closed with a generic point. A specialization-invariant subset is a union of the components it meets; it is closed. Apply this to each fibre and its complement to prove fibres open and hence local constancy.
